title: Co-exposure to benzoic acid and acesulfame K synergistically induces nephrotoxicity through the CTNNB1/STAT3 axis.
authors: Ma, Yufeng; Mai, Xinyue; Fan, Wenxi; Sun, Xue; He, Yongsen; Zhang, Jielu; Wang, Tianbao; Zuo, Yi; Zhang, Tingting; Lu, Jun
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 研究食品添加剂苯甲酸与安赛蜜联合肾毒性，涉及蛋白互作网络与分子模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Benzoic acid (BA) and acesulfame K (ACE) are commonly co-present food additives, yet their combined nephrotoxic risk remains poorly understood. Employing network toxicology, molecular simulations, and in vitro assays, we systematically evaluated their individual and combined effects on nephrotoxicity. Computational predictions indicated that both compounds exhibited nephrotoxic propensity, with shared targets enriched in pathways such as "response to xenobiotic stimulus" and metabolic disruption. Protein-protein interaction network analysis identified CTNNB1 and STAT3 as the respective core targets for BA and ACE, with molecular simulations confirming their stable binding. In vitro experiments showed that BA alone inhibited HK2 cell proliferation, and downregulated beta-catenin (encoded by CTNNB1). ACE alone did not significantly suppress proliferation but activated STAT3 signaling. Notably, combined exposure produced a marked synergistic anti-proliferative effect, attributable to a dual mechanism: BA impaired renal tubular repair capacity by suppressing the CTNNB1/beta-catenin pathway, while ACE exacerbated inflammatory and injury responses via STAT3 activation, thereby simultaneously impairing repair and exacerbating damage in the kidney. This study is the first to reveal that BA and ACE have the potential to synergistically induce nephrotoxicity via the CTNNB1/STAT3 signaling axis, providing new scientific evidence for the systematic safety assessment of mixed food-additive exposures.
abstract_zh: 苯甲酸（BA）和安赛蜜钾（ACE）是常见的共存食品添加剂，然而它们联合使用的肾毒性风险仍知之甚少。利用网络毒理学、分子模拟和体外实验，我们系统评估了它们单独及联合对肾毒性的影响。计算预测表明，这两种化合物均表现出肾毒性倾向，其共享靶点富集于“外源刺激反应”和代谢紊乱等通路。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析确定CTNNB1和STAT3分别为BA和ACE的核心靶点，分子模拟证实了它们的稳定结合。体外实验显示，BA单独处理抑制HK2细胞增殖，并下调β-catenin（由CTNNB1编码）。ACE单独处理未显著抑制增殖，但激活了STAT3信号通路。值得注意的是，联合暴露产生了显著的协同抗增殖效应，这归因于双重机制：BA通过抑制CTNNB1/β-catenin通路损害肾小管修复能力，而ACE通过STAT3激活加剧炎症和损伤反应，从而同时损害肾脏修复并加重损伤。本研究首次揭示BA和ACE可能通过CTNNB1/STAT3信号轴协同诱导肾毒性，为混合食品添加剂暴露的系统安全性评估提供了新的科学证据。
